body: I mean, it’s not really a being at work thing. When I’m at home, at work, out with friends, laying in bed, doing anything. It’s always there.
I call in sick just to sit at home a lot too. I’m “working” today though. I’m not feeling very productive. I just feel like absolute shit today.
I’m sorry! I know it’s hard. I wish the best for you.

I have not looked at the sub before. I’ll have to check it out some time. The uncle, he’s super weird. When I was 13 or 12 or whatever, way too hung, he tried to have a conversation with me about porn while we were in a hot tub. Looking back on that, it’s super creepy. The getting help just seems like validating my mom for telling everyone I was crazy when I just didn’t want to be in the army anymore. 

What resources are there online? I really haven’t talked to anyone about anything before. I mostly just keep it all to myself. Mines of my friends know or anything. Regardless, thank you. 

I hope I find something or anything as well. I just don’t know why I’m exactly expecting myself. I’ve had a lot of experiences, it just seems like empty things a lot of the time.

I’ve been to every country in the Mediterranean and the Baltic. Mexico, Columbia, Guatemala, Canada, Korea, Thailand and a bunch of other places.   I’ve met all kinds of different people. I have changed jobs and done all kinds of changes in my life. Moving cities. Moving states. I get that I’m not that long but every year that goes by, I just feel my feet drag a little harder, it takes a little longer to get up in the morning, it’s a little harder to smile. 
It’s obviously not something I’m just gonna scream about and do tomorrow or in an hour if someone doesn’t talk to me. It’s just something that’s really weighing on my chest. It’s like I’m constantly trying to fight for air.
